summary: Tested 4 new features: Monthly PDF report, Excel/CSV exports, Reminders panel, Student Detail drawer. Backend pytest (16 tests) all pass. Frontend end-to-end via Playwright confirms: admin nav shows Hatırlatmalar/Aylık Rapor/Denetim/Kullanıcılar; ogretmen role hides them (also hides Tahsilat/Payments). Student row click opens right-side drawer with 6-row taksit planı + tahsilat geçmişi (verified with student-001, 6 installments). Reminders page shows blue NetGSM banner and 17 WhatsApp deep-links with valid wa.me URLs. Aylık Rapor page generates a valid PDF (248KB, %PDF magic bytes) via axios blob download. Excel export for students returns valid xlsx (6.2KB). Audit endpoint enforces admin-only (403 for muhasebe/ogretmen). Audit log receives report.monthly and export.excel entries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_installment_plan uses min(start.day, 28) as the day of month to avoid invalid February dates. This shifts all due dates to <=28, which is acceptable but note the fee is due 'up to' the 28th instead of user-configured day.

server.py /reminders always includes ALL students regardless of role - fine for admin/muhasebe (RBAC not enforced at endpoint) but ogretmen (if navigated directly via URL) could also fetch. Currently hidden in nav only; consider role guard at endpoint for defense-in-depth.

server.py /export/{kind} allows students/payments/expenses/all for any authed user including ogretmen. Only 'audit' is admin-gated. Consider gating exports to admin/muhasebe if data privacy is a concern.
server.py /reports/monthly accessible to all roles including ogretmen. Spec allows this, but consider restricting to admin/muhasebe (matches frontend CAN.reports_view).
Frontend App.js is now ~430 lines with many components in one file - approaching split threshold (700). No immediate action needed.
seed_data_creation: Existing seed students (student-001 Eylül, student-002 Arda) plus prior TEST_* students used. No new data created this iteration beyond audit-log entries triggered by report + export.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py toggles user role via MongoDB. Runs under pytest-xdist with -n 2 loadscope. Uses openpyxl to validate xlsx and checks %PDF magic bytes. For frontend PDF download testing, use page.expect_download() with the download button data-testid=download-report-button. Student detail drawer opens via clicking [data-testid=student-row-<id>]. Consider adding a role guard at backend /reports/monthly and non-audit /export endpoints if privacy tightens.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features working as specified.
